# Paper Arcade

A collection of five hand-built browser games presented as a 1960s print shop.
Static site: hand-written HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No frameworks, no build
step, no backend, no analytics, no ads.

## Pages
- index.html: home, game lineup, house rules
- lexicon.html: daily five-letter word game (Wordle-like), with free play mode
- drift.html: 2048-style sliding tile merge puzzle with undo
- minefield.html: minesweeper with three sheet sizes and first-click safety
- pairs.html: memory match with two sheet sizes
- signal.html: sequence memory with tones and strict mode
- stats.html: local-only record desk reading localStorage
- about.html: colophon with design system, motion rules, changelog

## Design language
Paper #f3eee3, ink #191510, riso orange #e8511c, press green #2b6e62,
mustard #d9a514. Fonts: Fraunces (display) and Space Mono (UI). Hard offset
shadows, 2px rules, halftone paper texture. "Ink mode" is a dark variant.

## Privacy
All scores are stored in the player's browser via localStorage under the
"pa:" prefix. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is tracked.
